hanzi: 今天晚上我想在家吃鱼。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ xiǎng zài jiā chī yú.
english: I want to eat fish at home this evening.

hanzi: 明天我们去商店买衣服。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen qù shāngdiàn mǎi yīfu.
english: Tomorrow we are going to the store to buy clothes.

pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè bùcuò.
english: The color of this piece of clothing is pretty good.

hanzi: 这件衣服有点儿大，我不买。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎnr dà, wǒ bù mǎi.
english: This piece of clothing is a little big, so I will not buy it.

hanzi: 我觉得考试以后要休息。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde kǎoshì yǐhòu yào xiūxi.
english: I think I need to rest after the exam.

hanzi: 我不喜欢喝咖啡，我喜欢喝茶。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan hē kāfēi, wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
english: I do not like coffee; I like tea.

pinyin: Tā měitiān zài jiā hē kāfēi.
english: She drinks coffee at home every day.

hanzi: 我想买一件衣服，不想买两件。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn yīfu, bù xiǎng mǎi liǎng jiàn.
english: I want to buy one piece of clothing, not two.
